# kernels.sigclip_mask { #imcombiners.kernels.sigclip_mask }

```python
kernels.sigclip_mask(

    *,
    mask=None,
    sigma=(3.0, 3.0),
    maxiters=5,
    ddof=0,
    nkeep=1,
    maxrej=None,
    cenfunc='median',
    clip_cen=None,

    validate=True,
```
